name: CHSA free lunches and free printing (Coffs Harbour)
summary: Free lunches through the year for all SCU students and free printing from the Uni Lounge computers at the Coffs Harbour campus.
key: Free lunches throughout the year for active members and all SCU students, and free printing from Uni Lounge computers.
who: SCU students at the Coffs Harbour campus. A student ID card is needed to print.
how: Check the CHSA calendar and social channels for lunch days.

evidence.quote: The CHSA offers active members as well as all SCU students free lunches throughout the year!
Printing is available from all computers in the Uni Lounge, with free printing for students
